# BIP341 vectors

Source: https://github.com/bitcoin/bips/blob/927b6de9915c9262615a6399de51b200f81e5aa4/bip-0341/wallet-test-vectors.json

SHA-256: `403e19fb81dd1f31e745699216308f61fb403774b2aafa87b631b8f7c042d37f`. BIP341 is licensed BSD-3-Clause.
The secret keys in these published vectors are public test inputs, never wallet keys.
The K-04 profile uses only SIGHASH_DEFAULT. Other modes are not enabled.

Authors: Pieter Wuille, Jonas Nick and Anthony Towns. The BIP341 source declares
BSD-3-Clause in its header and Copyright section. The license terms are retained
in `BIP341-LICENSE.txt`.
